Scale Text Size. Increase or decrease the size of message text in Settings > Chat Settings on Android or Settings > Appearance on iOS.

On iOS, users can sync all text to their System setting, or set separate font sizes for chats and menus.

Verified Chats. Public figures and organizations can verify their public channel, group or bot so that users can be sure the chat is official.

Verified chats appear with a special badge in the chat list, chat headers and on their info pages.

Official messages from Telegram, such as service notifications and login codes only come from our verified accounts.

Admin Tools. Admins in groups can be given individual rights and custom titles to assign unique roles and responsibilities.

Giving all rights to an admin allows you to transfer ownership of the group.

Enabling ‘Remain Anonymous' makes an admin invisible – their messages will appear with the name and profile photo of the group.

Automatic Media Download. In Settings > Data and Storage, you can control when Telegram downloads media – based on connection, media format, chat type and file size.

Preset options for High, Medium and Low give quick options to save data, which you can modify into a custom setting.

To save storage space, try adjusting your Storage Usage settings.

Customizable Themes. Change the look of your app to your exact preferences – whether that be an animated background with your favorite colors, or a clean and simple dark theme.

Go to Settings > Chat Settings on Android or Appearance on iOS to change and tune your theme, with color options for your background and message bubbles, as well as several patterns.

All themes are shareable, so you can send your friends a link to your custom creations. For even more customization, you can set different themes for individual chats.

Anonymous Forwarding. In your Privacy Settings, you can control who is able to forward your messages by selecting a category like 'My Contacts' or adding exceptions.

When a message is forwarded by someone you allow, it will contain a link to your account – opening your profile when tapped. Messages forwarded by anyone else cannot link back to your account.

When forwarding messages, you are able to hide sender names and media captions.

Bulk Actions. Multiple chats can be pinned, muted, archived or deleted in one tap.

Press and hold a chat in your list to select it, then tap any others you'd like to include. You can also drag pinned chats to change their order.

On Android, the ➕ menu has more options like mark as read or add to folder.

On iOS you can do the same by tapping the Edit button in the top left corner.
